baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ couples a negated act of ء ت ي with the growth field of ز ك و.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negation blocks an outward transfer: الإيتاء supplies giving, while الزكاة supplies increase and growth. The object is therefore value whose growth depends on being rendered rather than retained.

activation_trace.role: Giving or bringing something over supplies the outward-transfer action that the negation blocks.
Increase and growth make the withheld object a growth-bearing yield rather than inert property.

changed_reading.after: They arrest a growth-bearing transfer by refusing to render what must circulate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ construction joins giving to purification and rectification.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because ز ك و also images purity and soundness, the omitted transfer is itself an available operation of repair. The failure is enacted: they decline to perform the act through which possession and possessor are put right.

activation_trace.role: Concrete giving makes purification an action to be rendered, not merely an inward quality.
Purity and rectification supply the repair that the refused act would perform.

changed_reading.after: They refuse an enacted purification that could set both wealth and self right.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ places covering directly against the later or deferred horizon.
baseline_models.mechanism: The later realm is the horizon postponed beyond the present, and كفر supplies concealment as well as doctrinal rejection. The emphatic second هُمْ makes non-giving and covering the deferred consequence two aspects of a settled posture.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the consequence-horizon kept beyond immediate view.
Covering gives the denial a spatial mechanism: the delayed horizon is screened from present conduct.
Concealment of truth keeps the material image attached to the explicit unbelief construction.

changed_reading.before: They withhold zakat and, separately, disbelieve in the afterlife.
changed_reading.after: Present withholding is sustained by screening off the delayed horizon in which its consequence becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence delivers and details discourse, then names covers over hearts, weight in ears, and a barrier between parties. The focus completes the circuit: nothing is admitted inward and no growth-bearing due is released outward, so كَافِرُونَ names a closed exchange system.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the blocked outward side of the exchange circuit.
Covering generalizes the several barriers into a single mechanism of closure.
Sending down and delivering supplies the attempted inward transmission.
A protective cover over the heart blocks reception at the inner boundary.
Weight in the ear blocks the auditory channel.
Prevention of access supplies the interpersonal barrier that seals the circuit.

structural_cues: 41:2-5 moves from delivered revelation to detailed signs, turning away, failed hearing, and three explicit barriers before 41:7 names non-giving and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, receptive barriers, non-giving, and covering; I infer one ingress-and-egress blockage. A live alternative is that 41:5 concerns only reception of discourse and does not govern material distribution.

changed_reading.after: They are closed at both boundaries: revelation does not enter and zakat does not leave, while كَافِرُونَ names the covering apparatus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is made steadily fruitful and its sustenance measured for askers; heaven and earth are then told to come and answer as willing participants. Against that sequence, not giving zakat is refusal to join a creation-wide pattern of responsive provisioning.

activation_trace.role: Growth supplies the productive capacity that should become provision.
Stable, increasing good makes the earth a durable source rather than a private store.
Life-sustaining food identifies the concrete good distributed by the ordered earth.
Request and need place the provision in relation to recipients.
Readiness and compliance turn the shared ء ت ي root into responsive availability.
Willing obedience supplies the contrast with the human refusal to render.

structural_cues: 41:10 places measured sustenance explicitly toward askers; 41:11 immediately stages a command to come and the answer 'we come willingly.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fruitful earth, apportioned sustenance, askers, and willing arrival; I infer that human giving participates analogically in that provisioning order. The live alternative is that cosmic compliance and human zakat remain parallel but separate obligations.

changed_reading.before: Non-giving is an isolated social omission.
changed_reading.after: Non-giving is refusal to participate in an ordered world where sources become fruitful, provision is measured for askers, and created domains make themselves responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: At judgment, hearing, sight, and skins testify; the addressees are told that their attempted covering never prevented that testimony. The bodily covering itself becomes a witness, reversing كفر from successful concealment into a self-defeating forensic strategy.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the attempted concealment that the judgment scene overturns.
Declaration grounded in knowledge converts hidden conduct into evidence.
The skin as bodily envelope makes a covering surface itself testify.
Explicit covering identifies concealment as a failed human tactic.
Presence with witnessing shows why no covering can remove the event from evidence.

structural_cues: 41:19-23 moves from gathering, through sensory and skin testimony, to the explicit statement that concealment could not stop the witnesses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover-language and testimony by the body's outer envelope; I infer a deliberate reversal of the focus root's material image. The live alternative is that the judgment passage targets hidden deeds generally without recalling كَافِرُونَ as covering.

changed_reading.before: كَافِرُونَ is a stable identity label.
changed_reading.after: كَافِرُونَ also depicts an attempted concealment whose own surfaces preserve and disclose the evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling, doing what repairs, and دفع with what is better transform an enemy into a near, warm ally. Read back into the focus, giving the purifier is not only subtraction from wealth; it is a counter-transfer capable of cleansing a damaged social relation and closing distance.

activation_trace.role: Giving anchors the later counter-action as an outward transfer.
Purification supplies the relational repair effected by the transfer.
Repair against corruption gives the good action a restorative function.
Doing good supplies the superior medium used in the reversal.
Pushing away harm supplies the immediate defensive direction.
Delivering or giving to another opens the same act toward counter-transfer rather than mere repulsion.
Nearness without a gap measures the spatial result of the repaired relation.
Close kinship or intimacy supplies the social endpoint of the reversal.

structural_cues: 41:33-35 sequences invitation, reparative action, response with the better, enemy-to-intimate reversal, and the patience needed to carry it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a better دفع and an explicit enemy-to-intimate reversal; I infer that transfer is the mechanism connecting this scene to purification-through-giving. The live alternative is that دفع means ethical response broadly, without a distributive or zakat-specific force.

changed_reading.before: Zakat is a ledger transfer that purifies its giver.
changed_reading.after: The purifying transfer can also be read as a countergift that clears hostility and converts social distance into protective nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus uses ء ت ي for what people refuse to send outward; 41:40 uses the same root for how one comes safely on the day of rising, and 41:46 makes each sound act accrue to the self. The outward transfer and later arrival become opposite legs of one return circuit.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the outward leg of the circuit.
The deferred horizon supplies the temporal interval across which the transfer returns.
Coming and arriving reverse the focus root from outgoing gift to the person's later mode of approach.
Security and settled trust specify the desired quality of that arrival.
Rising and resurrection identify the deferred destination.
Intentional action supplies the conduct that travels through the circuit.
Repair and soundness qualify the action that returns beneficially.
The self as the thing itself marks the eventual recipient of its own outward act.

structural_cues: 41:40 contrasts being cast into fire with coming secure on the day of rising; 41:46 states that sound action is for the actor's own self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated ء ت ي root, secure arrival, resurrection, and reflexive accrual of action; I supply the causal return arrow from present giving to later arrival. A live alternative is rhetorical lexical recurrence without a specific causal link to zakat.

changed_reading.before: Giving now and arriving in the afterlife are separate topics.
changed_reading.after: What is sent outward now participates in how the self comes back later; refusal of outflow and denial of arrival are one broken return circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late human portrait never tires of calling for good, receives mercy and says 'this is mine,' doubts the Hour, turns away when favored, and resumes expansive calling when harmed. The focus condenses that asymmetry: unlimited inward demand, blocked outward yield, ingratitude, and suppression of delayed accounting.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the outward movement absent from the one-way economy.
Growth identifies the surplus that is retained rather than released.
Covering a benefit by denying or failing to acknowledge it supplies the economy's ingratitude.
Lack of weariness under repetition makes inward solicitation effectively unbounded.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the repeated request for incoming good.
Desired benefit specifies what the inward-facing subject continually seeks.
Mercy and tenderness supply the received good that is immediately privatized.
Doubt and supposition loosen the claim of future accounting.
Ingratitude-covering names the failure to acknowledge benefaction within the same late portrait.
Favorable condition and benefaction supply the abundance after which withdrawal occurs.
Drawing the side away gives received abundance an outward posture of withdrawal.
The bodily side spatializes that retreat from reciprocal relation.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeats the cycle request for good, receipt, possessive claim, doubt of the Hour, withdrawal under favor, and renewed long prayer under harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a generic human cycle of asking, possession, doubt, withdrawal, and renewed asking; I infer that 41:7 compresses the same one-way economy. The live alternative is that the late generic human type is broader than the specific group named in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Failure to give and disbelief in the later life are adjacent faults.
changed_reading.after: They form one asymmetric economy: tirelessly solicit good, privatize mercy, retreat when enriched, and screen off delayed accounting so growth need never flow back out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending promises disclosure in distant horizons and within selves until truth becomes clear, names doubt about encounter, and closes with total encompassing. The focus's coverers try to screen the later horizon, but the surah reverses enclosure: evidence emerges both outside and inside, and the would-be coverers are themselves encompassed.

activation_trace.role: The other or later horizon is the domain the focus subjects reject.
Covering supplies the attempted enclosure that the ending reverses.
Distant horizons expand disclosure beyond the subject's managed field.
The self itself supplies an internal site of evidence.
Emergence and disclosure move truth out of concealment.
Stable correspondence with reality names what the disclosure establishes.
Doubt and hesitation directly characterize resistance to the encounter.
Two things meeting face to face turns the later horizon into unavoidable encounter.
Complete encompassing in knowledge reverses agency: the coverers cannot stand outside the enclosing field.

structural_cues: 41:53 moves from signs in outer horizons to signs within selves and disclosure of truth; 41:54 moves from doubt of meeting to comprehensive encompassing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer and inner disclosure, doubted encounter, and total encompassing; I infer a reversal of the focus's cover-image. The live alternative is that the ending answers doubt epistemically without developing a spatial counter-enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The subjects cover the reality of the later life.
changed_reading.after: Their covering is trapped inside a larger field: outer horizons and inner selves disclose what they screen, and the coverers are themselves fully encompassed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates agricultural and fruit-sheath branches of ك ف ر and a yield branch of ء ت ي rather than the ordinary clause-level senses. It remains anchored in all three focus roots and is reinforced by the packet's watered-earth growth and fruit emerging from covers. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for arrested yield, not as a replacement translation of كَافِرُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُؤْتُونَ can image released yield, زَكَوٰة names growth, and كَافِرُونَ carries both seed-covering and fruit-sheath branches.

activation_trace.role: Emergent produce and yield recast the negated act as failure to bring growth forth.
Increase and plant growth supply the outlier's productive process.
A farmer covering seed supplies a potentially productive enclosure whose validity depends on later emergence.
The sheath around fruit supplies the image of growth still enclosed and unreleased.
Delivered water initiates the packet's explicit growth cycle.
Conveying water by irrigation or pouring supplies the channel that enables dormant growth.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life marks successful activation under the cover.
Increase and rising make released growth visible.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the decisive release movement.
Ripe fruit supplies the completed yield expected from growth.
The plant vessel and fruit wrapper give the packet an explicit sheath from which fruit emerges.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels unbelievers who withhold alms.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they are sterile coverers: growth stays sheathed and no yield comes forth, unlike watered earth and fruit emerging from its covers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it contrasts the expiatory branch within ك ف ر with the ordinary truth-covering force of كَافِرُونَ. It remains anchored in the focus's purification and covering roots and in the immediately preceding call to seek forgiveness. Downstream prose should state a contrast among branch images, not claim that كَافِرُونَ itself means expiation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ز ك و offers purification while ك ف ر contains both truth-covering and a distinct image of covering away an offense.

activation_trace.role: Purity and rectification supply the repair being refused.
Covering truth supplies the obstructive direction actually attached to the unbelief construction.
Covering an offense until its effect is erased supplies the restorative counter-direction within the root inventory.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies the adjacent offered route of repair.

changed_reading.before: They refuse purification and cover truth.
changed_reading.after: The adjacency stages opposed coverings: seek a protective covering that removes sin's effect and permits repair, or cover truth while refusing the purifying act.

strongest_changes: The focus became a closed exchange circuit: delivered signs are blocked on entry and growth-bearing zakat is blocked on exit.
Cosmic provisioning and the repeated ء ت ي root made giving an act of participation whose outward movement returns as one's later mode of arrival.
41:49-51 fused non-giving and afterlife denial into one asymmetric economy of endless asking, possessive receipt, withdrawal, and screened accounting.
Judgment testimony reversed covering into a failed forensic strategy, while the ending reversed enclosure by placing the coverers inside comprehensive disclosure.
The strongest exploratory material image was sterile covering: unlike watered earth and fruit leaving their sheaths, retained growth never comes forth.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence turned two adjacent accusations into mechanisms of blocked circulation, failed concealment, reciprocal return, and counter-enclosure; the botanical convergence at 41:39 and 41:47 was the least conservative live activation.
remaining_uncertainties: The link between cosmic provisioning and human zakat is analogical and may be thematic rather than a direct causal claim.
The agricultural and expiatory ك ف ر branches are diagnostically productive but should remain contained material contrasts in downstream prose.
The generic human cycle in 41:49-51 may illuminate rather than directly identify the group named in 41:7.
